title: Version Control dock visibility issues
body:
### Tested versions

- 4.7.2, Since https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/115482

### System information

Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors (2400x1350 @ 60.00 Hz, 1920x1080 @ 60.00 Hz) - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 (NVIDIA; 32.0.16.1088) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-10750H CPU @ 2.60GHz (12 threads) - 15.82 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Opening the Editor after the Commit dock was closed opens the Version Control dock. The only way to close it is to open the Commit dock from the menu and then close it.

Loading a layout with the Commit dock opened or closed does not correspondingly open or close the Version Control dock. 
The signals are not correct here, I think `closed` only make sense to use for transient docks since they don't close when loading layouts. I'm not sure what the `opened` signal would be useful for since it doesn't handle everywhere it opens. We should probably deprecate it so users don't try to rely on it for code that needs to run when their dock opens.
The `closed` signal documentation can also be updated to clarify the dock may close in other ways.
Or we can update the signals to just emit in every case they are opened or closed.

Also it would be great if the Version Control dock could be closed directly since it is more visible than the Commit dock which by default gets hidden behind the other docks in its slot. It's fine to set it as closable, it automatically opens when needed, and users can finish using it while still wanting the Commit dock open.

The Version Control dock should also be closed by default and only opened when the Commit dock needs it, rather than when the Commit dock opens IMO. It doesn't show anything by default, so its not useful to have open until something is selected in the Commit dock.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Setup VCS
2. Close the Commit dock (which closes the Version Control dock)
3. Reload the editor (avoiding https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/107089)
4. The Version Control dock is open but the Commit dock is closed, and it cannot directly be closed.

For layouts 
1. Add an editor layout with the Commit dock open
2. Close the Commit dock
3. Add an editor layout with the Commit dock closed
4. Load the opened layout, see that the Version Control dock does not open
5. Manually close and reopen from the menu
6. Load the closed layout, see that the Version Control dock does not close
